videos.title: Big Buck Bunny
videos.description: A large, lovable rabbit deals with three bullying rodents who ruin his afternoon. A heartwarming tale of revenge featuring stunning CGI animation from the Blender Foundation.

videos.title: Elephant's Dream
videos.description: Two strange characters explore a whimsical mechanical world in this surreal open-source short film, the first open movie produced by the Blender Foundation.

videos.title: Sintel
videos.description: A wandering young woman searches for a small dragon she has befriended, journeying across a vast and perilous world. A visually stunning open film from the Blender Institute.

videos.title: Tears of Steel
videos.description: In a post-apocalyptic Amsterdam, warriors and scientists make a final stand against a robot invasion. A sci-fi short blending live action and CGI from the Blender Institute.

videos.title: Nosferatu (1922)
videos.description: An unauthorized adaptation of Dracula, this German Expressionist masterpiece follows Count Orlok as he terrorizes a young couple and their Transylvanian village. Directed by F.W. Murnau.

videos.title: The General (1926)
videos.description: Confederate train engineer Johnnie Gray pursues Union spies who have stolen his beloved locomotive during the Civil War. Buster Keaton's comedic masterpiece with incredible practical stunts.

videos.title: Metropolis (1927)
videos.description: In a dystopian future city, the son of a wealthy industrialist falls in love with a working-class prophet who advocates for the rights of the oppressed. Fritz Lang's landmark science fiction epic.

videos.title: Night of the Living Dead (1968)
videos.description: A group of people barricade themselves in a rural farmhouse to survive an onslaught of flesh-eating zombies. George A. Romero's groundbreaking horror film that defined the zombie genre.

videos.title: Sherlock Jr. (1924)
videos.description: A film projectionist who longs to be a detective falls asleep on the job and dreams himself into the movie on screen. Buster Keaton's inventive comedy is a meditation on cinema itself.

videos.title: For Bigger Blazes
videos.description: A high-octane short demo featuring explosive action sequences and cinematic stunts.

videos.title: For Bigger Escapes
videos.description: A breathtaking short featuring daring escapes and fast-paced action. Compact cinematic excitement.

videos.title: For Bigger Fun
videos.description: A lively short clip packed with energy and spectacle. Pure fun in under a minute.

videos.title: We Are Going On Bullrun
videos.description: A spirited road adventure following participants of the legendary Bullrun rally across scenic American highways. Fast cars, big personalities, open roads.
